blocks.html:
NEWS - Meet the ESA: three events in Switzerland between late September and early October 2026

Space eXchange Switzerland is bringing the ESA to three Swiss universities: you will have the opportunity to meet ESA professionals and experts and, during individual counselling sessions, discuss your interests, needs and professional goals, receiving practical guidance from people working in the sector.

The events are open to students and recent graduates from all Swiss universities, including USI, and participation is free of charge.

  • Geneva - Wednesday, 30 September 2026, 17.00 – 19.30, Université de Genève - Register here
  • Lausanne - Thursday, 1 October 2026, 17.30 – 19.30, EPFL - Register here
  • Zurich - Friday, 2 October 2026, 12.30 – 15.00, ETH Zürich - Register here

You will have the opportunity to meet Johann Richard (Head of ESDI), Andrew Kane (Entry Level Programmes Coordinator), Nigel Savage (ESA Academy Administrator Training), as well as ESA Graduate Trainees and interns.

If you are a citizen of an eligible ESA Member State, you can also book an individual counselling session (1:1) with a Counsellor to receive feedback on your CV and tailored advice on your application and professional career path.

Places are limited and bookings are made on a first-come, first-served basis.

The events will be held in English.

For the latest information and any last-minute updates: www.space-exchange.ch/events

USI Career Service is the career partner of Space Exchange Switzerland (SXS), the national platform for the promotion of space in Switzerland, funded by the Swiss Space Office (SSO) of the State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SEFRI). The SXS consortium comprises five partners: EPFL Lausanne (Leading House), ETH Zurich, UZH Zurich, FHNW Brugg, and USI Lugano.

The role of the USI Career Service is to attract young talents who are studying or have studied at Swiss universities to pursue a career in the space sector. Thanks to the USI Career Service, ESA has recorded a 610% increase in internship applications from Swiss students over the past five years.

Do you want to be informed about the SXS career news? Register here.

Are you a Master's student or recent Graduate in Computer Science, Economics, Communication, Biomedicine, or Architecture at USI and interested in an internship or a job at the European Space Agency (ESA)?

ESA offers opportunities to Master's graduates and recent graduates in Engineering, Medicine, Computer Science/Robotics/Cybersecurity/IT/Data Science, Business, and Communication.

  • ESA Internships: short-term internships (3-6 months); applications open in November.

  • ESA Graduate Traineeships (EGT): one-year contracts working on space projects.

  • ESA Junior Professional Programme (JPP): four-year contracts for Master's graduates with up to 3 years of professional experience.

Discover all opportunities for students and recent graduates: Careers at ESA.

COUNSELING FOR SPACE CAREERS

SXS and the USI Career Service support your application from Switzerland:
Request personalized counselling

  • Get in touch with SXS Counsellors
  • You can also count on the firsthand experience of Camillo Malnati (MSc in Software & Data Engineering, USI 2020), a USI Alumnus and former participant in the ESA Young Graduate Trainee Programme (YGT), currently pursuing a career in the space sector.
  • Watch the video "SXS Career: Tips for an Impactful Job Application"
  • Watch the interview with astronaut Claude Nicollier

SPACE INTERNSHIP SCHOLARSHIPS

If you study at a university or professional school in Switzerland and are selected for a foreign-based space internship, you can apply to the USI Career service for a Mobility SXS/Movetia Scholarship.
Find all the details here.

INTERNSHIP

Already 77 students have completed their internships at space agencies @ ESA and @ NASA/JPL, as well as in private companies.

  • Overall satisfaction rating: 4.5 / 5
